column1: event|01-11|1923|Θάνατος του βασιλιά Κωνσταντίνου Α' στην εξορία|Death of King Constantine I in exile|Former king Constantine I died in Palermo, Sicily, where he had lived in exile since 1922. He died of a cerebral haemorrhage, and his death closed the life of the king who had led Greece through the Balkan Wars.

event|04-01|1947|Θάνατος του βασιλιά Γεωργίου Β'|Death of King George II|King George II died in Athens and was succeeded by his brother Paul. His death came during the Greek Civil War, at a time of intense political conflict.

event|10-13|1904|Θάνατος του Παύλου Μελά|Death of Pavlos Melas|Pavlos Melas, leader of the Macedonian Struggle, was killed in battle against Ottoman forces at Statista in Macedonia. His death became a symbol of the struggle for Greek Macedonia.
